items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio walkthrough of hardware constraints — screen size, resolution, input methods, and processing power — and how they shape interface design decisions.

items.title: The three ways that good design makes you happy — Don Norman TED
items.description: Don Norman, the UX pioneer who coined 'user experience', explains why hardware and interface design must work together to feel satisfying.

items.title: Graphical User Interfaces: Crash Course Computer Science #26
items.description: Covers how GUIs evolved from command lines to touchscreens — directly relevant to why hardware dictates interface choices.

items.title: 100+ Web Development Things you Should Know — Fireship
items.description: Fast-paced overview of responsive design, viewport sizing, and how developers accommodate different hardware — links to the lesson's core themes.

items.title: Minority Report (2002)
items.description: Spielberg's vision of gesture-based, holographic interfaces — a bold imagining of where hardware-driven UX design could go.

items.title: MDN — Responsive Design
items.description: Mozilla's free guide to designing interfaces that adapt to any screen size or device — essential reading for this lesson.

items.title: OCR Cambridge Nationals IT — Specification at a Glance
items.description: Check the hardware and interface design content in the OCR J836 spec to know exactly what the exam requires.
